topics.title: Perseid meteor shower nears peak
topics.summary: The Perseid meteor shower is building toward its midweek peak, with dark-sky viewers in the Northern Hemisphere expected to get a strong summer show if clouds cooperate.
topics.discussionPrompt: If everyone on the couch had to make one wish on a meteor, who would say theirs out loud and who would pretend they didn't see it?

topics.title: European athletics arrives in Birmingham
topics.summary: Birmingham is preparing to host the 2026 European Athletics Championships from August 10 to 16, bringing top continental track and field athletes to Alexander Stadium.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a big sports event comes to town, are you more excited about the athletes, the crowds, or the snacks people invent for watching?

topics.title: College sports bill waits for fall
topics.summary: A U.S. Senate bill on college sports and athlete compensation missed a vote before recess, but it has been placed on the September calendar.
topics.discussionPrompt: If college sports had a salary cap conversation at the diner, who would bring a spreadsheet and who would just argue from vibes?

topics.title: Canada benefit dates get attention
topics.summary: Canada's official benefits calendar lists several August payment dates, including child benefit, disability, pension, and provincial family benefit programs.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a payment date lands on the calendar, is it a budgeting moment, a grocery-list moment, or a tiny sigh-of-relief moment?
